name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited,  incorporated  in  1993 ,  is  a  Electronic  Manufacturing  Services  (EMS)  company  with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras  (CCTVs), and mobile  phones. It also  undertakes reverse logistics operations.  Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India.

ar.what_they_do: Dixon Technologies is a leading electronic manufacturing services provider in India, specializing in mobile phones, telecom equipment, IT hardware, and consumer electronics components.

segments.name: Mobile Phones
segments.note: Manufactures mobile phones and related components.

segments.name: Telecom and Network Products
segments.note: Includes 5G FWA, set-top boxes, and landline phones.

segments.name: IT Hardware
segments.note: Manufactures laptops, notebooks, and smart products.

segments.name: Consumer Electronics & Components
segments.note: Includes camera and fingerprint recognition modules.

bull.point: Exceptional multi-year compounding with revenue 3y CAGR at 58.9% and PAT at 86.1%.
Strong operating cash flow generation exceeding reported profits over a 5-year period.
Massive expansion in component manufacturing capacities like camera modules and refrigerators.

bear.point: Significant debt accumulation with borrowings expanding 2.5x over three years.
Volatile bottom-line performance with sharp profit declines in recent quarters.
bear.evidence: PAT down 44.9% YoY to ₹411 Cr in Q2 FY27

bear.point: Operating margins remain thin and under pressure despite massive revenue scale.
